title: Profile images that read as trust
purpose: A sharp banner and headshot, graded to match: the first trust signal.
why: A recruiter decides in seconds. Sharp, consistent images are the first trust signal before a word is read.
evidence: Both images live on your profile.

tasks.title: Add 1 to 3 photos of your face
how: Face a window, hold your phone at eye level, and take off any sunglasses.
Add your current profile photo and banner too, if you have them.
tasks.done_when: At least one clear photo of your face is added.

tasks.title: Pick your headshot
how: We make three from your photos, dressed for the job you want, with the same face.
Pick the one that looks most like you on a good day. Ask for three more if none do.
tasks.done_when: You picked a headshot that looks like you.

tasks.title: Pick your banner
how: We make three from the job you're aiming at and the style words you gave us.
Pick the one you'd be glad to have behind your name.
tasks.done_when: You picked a banner that matches your headshot.

tasks.title: Download both and put them on your LinkedIn profile
how: Download each one at LinkedIn's sizes from the last step of the tool.
On LinkedIn, open your profile: click your photo to change it, and the camera on the banner to change that.
tasks.done_when: Both images are live on your profile.

video.title: Profile images that read as trust
video.summary: Why the banner and headshot are read before any word, and how to make both look like the same person in the same seat.
